                .uefi => ".efi",

                else => switch (arch) {
                    .wasm32, .wasm64 => ".wasm",
                    .spork8 => ".bin",
                    else => "",

                .msvc, .itanium => ".lib",
                else => switch (tag) {
                    .windows, .uefi => ".lib",
                    else => ".a",

                .maccatalyst,
                .macos,
                .tvos,
                .visionos,

        /// 返回第一个版本 `ver` 是否不早于（大于或等于）第二个版本 `ver`。
        pub inline fn isAtLeast(ver: WindowsVersion, min_ver: WindowsVersion) bool {

        pub const Range = struct {
            min: WindowsVersion,
            max: WindowsVersion,

            pub inline fn includesVersion(range: Range, ver: WindowsVersion) bool {
                return @backingInt(ver) >= @backingInt(range.min) and
                    @backingInt(ver) <= @backingInt(range.max);
            }

            /// 检查系统是否保证至少为 `version`，或早于 `version`。
            /// 若需要运行期检查，则返回 `null`。
            pub inline fn isAtLeast(range: Range, min_ver: WindowsVersion) ?bool {
                if (@backingInt(range.min) >= @backingInt(min_ver)) return true;
                if (@backingInt(range.max) < @backingInt(min_ver)) return false;
                return null;
            }
        };

        pub fn parse(str: []const u8) !WindowsVersion {
            return std.meta.stringToEnum(WindowsVersion, str) orelse
                @fromBackingInt(@intCast(std.fmt.parseInt(u32, str, 0) catch
                    return error.InvalidOperatingSystemVersion));
        }

        /// 此函数用于将该类型序列化为 Zig 源码表示，
        /// 解析此表示时将反序列化出相同的数据。
        pub fn format(wv: WindowsVersion, w: *std.Io.Writer) std.Io.Writer.Error!void {
            if (std.enums.tagName(WindowsVersion, wv)) |name| {
                var vecs: [2][]const u8 = .{ ".", name };
                return w.writeVecAll(&vecs);
            } else {
                return w.print("@fromBackingInt(0x{X:0>8})", .{wv});
            }
        }
    };

    pub const TaggedVersionRange = union(enum) {
        none: void,
        semver: std.SemanticVersion.Range,
        hurd: HurdVersionRange,
        linux: LinuxVersionRange,
        windows: WindowsVersion.Range,

        pub fn gnuLibCVersion(range: TaggedVersionRange) ?std.SemanticVersion {
            return switch (range) {
                .none, .semver, .windows => null,
                .hurd => |h| h.glibc,
                .linux => |l| l.glibc,
            };
        }
    };

    /// 提供标签联合体。`Target` 不存储标签，因为标签与操作系统标签重复；此函数将这部分抽象出来。
    ///
    pub inline fn versionRange(os: Os) TaggedVersionRange {
        return switch (os.tag.versionRangeTag()) {
            .none => .{ .none = {} },
            .semver => .{ .semver = os.version_range.semver },
            .hurd => .{ .hurd = os.version_range.hurd },
            .linux => .{ .linux = os.version_range.linux },
            .windows => .{ .windows = os.version_range.windows },
        };
    }

    /// 检查系统是否保证至少为 `version`，或早于 `version`。
    /// 若需要运行期检查，则返回 `null`。
    pub inline fn isAtLeast(os: Os, comptime tag: Tag, ver: switch (tag.versionRangeTag()) {
        .none => void,
        .semver, .hurd, .linux => std.SemanticVersion,
        .windows => WindowsVersion,
    }) ?bool {
        return if (os.tag != tag) false else switch (tag.versionRangeTag()) {
            .none => true,
            inline .semver,
            .hurd,
            .linux,
            .windows,
            => |field| @field(os.version_range, @tagName(field)).isAtLeast(ver),
        };
    }
};

                else => .none,
            },

                .arm => .eabihf,
                else => .none,
            },
            .hurd => .gnu,
            .linux => switch (arch) {
                .arm,
                .armeb,
                .powerpc,
                .powerpcle,
                .thumb,

                => .musleabihf,

                .mipsel,

            .gnuabi64,
            .gnueabi,
            .gnueabihf,
            .gnuf32,
            .gnusf,

            .muslabi64,
            .musleabi,
            .musleabihf,
            .muslf32,
            .muslsf,

        return switch (abi) {
            .ohos, .ohoseabi => true,

    pub inline fn isAndroid(abi: Abi) bool {
        return switch (abi) {
            .android, .androideabi => true,
            else => false,

pub const ObjectFormat = enum {
    /// C 源代码。
    c,
    /// Windows 和 UEFI 使用的通用对象文件格式。
    coff,
    /// 许多 Unix 系统使用的可执行与可链接格式。
    elf,
    /// Intel HEX 格式，用于以 ASCII 文本存储二进制代码。
    hex,
    /// macOS 及其他 Apple 平台使用的 Mach 对象格式。
    macho,
    /// Bell Labs 的 Plan 9 使用的 a.out 格式。
    plan9,
    /// 不含元数据的机器代码。
    raw,
    /// Khronos Group 的标准可移植中间表示 V。
    spirv,
    /// WebAssembly 二进制格式。
    wasm,

    pub fn fileExt(of: ObjectFormat, arch: Cpu.Arch) [:0]const u8 {
        return switch (of) {
            .c => ".c",
            .coff => ".obj",
            .elf, .macho, .wasm => ".o",
            .hex => ".ihex",
            .plan9 => arch.plan9Ext(),
            .raw => ".bin",
            .spirv => ".spv",
        };
    }

    pub fn default(os_tag: Os.Tag, arch: Cpu.Arch) ObjectFormat {
        return switch (os_tag) {
            .driverkit, .ios, .maccatalyst, .macos, .tvos, .visionos, .watchos => .macho,
            .plan9 => .plan9,
            .uefi, .windows => .coff,
            else => switch (arch) {
                .spirv32, .spirv64 => .spirv,
                .wasm32, .wasm64 => .wasm,
                .spork8 => .raw,
                else => .elf,
            },
        };
    }
};

pub const Cpu = struct {
    /// 架构
    arch: Arch,

    /// 目标 CPU 型号。它具有一组特性，
    /// 可由 `features` 字段覆盖。
    model: *const Model,

    /// 明确列出完整 CPU 特性集。它可能不同于具体 CPU 型号的特性。
    features: Feature.Set,

    pub const Feature = struct {
        /// `Set` 中的位索引。默认值为 `undefined`，
        /// 因为规范结构通过编译期逻辑填充。
        index: Set.Index = undefined,

        /// 默认值为 `undefined`，
        /// 因为规范结构由编译时逻辑填充。
        name: []const u8 = undefined,

        /// 若对应 LLVM 识别的特性，则填充此值；
        /// 否则为 null。
        llvm_name: ?[:0]const u8,

        /// 便于人阅读的 UTF-8 文本。
        description: []const u8,

        /// 所依赖特性的稀疏 `Set`。
        dependencies: Set,

        /// 包含全部功能的位集合。
        pub const Set = struct {
            ints: [usize_count]usize,

            pub const needed_bit_count = 347;
            pub const byte_count = @divCeil(needed_bit_count, 8);
            pub const usize_count = (byte_count + (@sizeOf(usize) - 1)) / @sizeOf(usize);
            pub const Index = std.math.Log2Int(@Int(.unsigned, usize_count * @bitSizeOf(usize)));
            pub const ShiftInt = std.math.Log2Int(usize);

            pub const empty: Set = .{ .ints = @splat(0) };

            pub fn isEmpty(set: Set) bool {
                return for (set.ints) |x| {
                    if (x != 0) break false;
                } else true;
            }

            pub fn count(set: Set) std.math.IntFittingRange(0, needed_bit_count) {
                var sum: usize = 0;
                for (set.ints) |x| sum += @popCount(x);
                return @intCast(sum);
            }

            pub fn isEnabled(set: Set, arch_feature_index: Index) bool {
                const usize_index = arch_feature_index / @bitSizeOf(usize);
                const bit_index: ShiftInt = @intCast(arch_feature_index % @bitSizeOf(usize));
                return (set.ints[usize_index] & (@as(usize, 1) << bit_index)) != 0;
            }

            /// 添加指定特性，但不添加其依赖。
            pub fn addFeature(set: *Set, arch_feature_index: Index) void {
                const usize_index = arch_feature_index / @bitSizeOf(usize);
                const bit_index: ShiftInt = @intCast(arch_feature_index % @bitSizeOf(usize));
                set.ints[usize_index] |= @as(usize, 1) << bit_index;
            }

            /// 添加指定特性集，但不添加其依赖。
            pub fn addFeatureSet(set: *Set, other_set: Set) void {
                set.ints = @as(@Vector(usize_count, usize), set.ints) | @as(@Vector(usize_count, usize), other_set.ints);
            }

            /// 移除指定特性，但不移除依赖它的特性。
            pub fn removeFeature(set: *Set, arch_feature_index: Index) void {
                const usize_index = arch_feature_index / @bitSizeOf(usize);
                const bit_index: ShiftInt = @intCast(arch_feature_index % @bitSizeOf(usize));
                set.ints[usize_index] &= ~(@as(usize, 1) << bit_index);
            }

            /// 移除指定特性，但不移除依赖它的特性。
            pub fn removeFeatureSet(set: *Set, other_set: Set) void {
                set.ints = @as(@Vector(usize_count, usize), set.ints) & ~@as(@Vector(usize_count, usize), other_set.ints);
            }

            pub fn populateDependencies(set: *Set, all_features_list: []const Cpu.Feature) void {
                @setEvalBranchQuota(1000000);

                var old = set.ints;
                while (true) {
                    for (all_features_list, 0..) |feature, index_usize| {
                        const index: Index = @intCast(index_usize);
                        if (set.isEnabled(index)) {
                            set.addFeatureSet(feature.dependencies);
                        }
                    }
                    const nothing_changed = std.mem.eql(usize, &old, &set.ints);
                    if (nothing_changed) return;
                    old = set.ints;
                }
            }

            pub fn asBytes(set: *const Set) *const [byte_count]u8 {
                return std.mem.sliceAsBytes(&set.ints)[0..byte_count];
            }

            pub fn eql(set: Set, other_set: Set) bool {
                return std.mem.eql(usize, &set.ints, &other_set.ints);
            }

            pub fn isSuperSetOf(set: Set, other_set: Set) bool {
                const V = @Vector(usize_count, usize);
                const set_v: V = set.ints;
                const other_v: V = other_set.ints;
                return @reduce(.And, (set_v & other_v) == other_v);
            }
        };

        pub fn FeatureSetFns(comptime F: type) type {
            return struct {
                /// 只填充指定的特性位。
                pub fn featureSet(features: []const F) Set {
                    var x = Set.empty;
                    for (features) |feature| {
                        x.addFeature(@backingInt(feature));
                    }
                    return x;
                }

                /// 若指定特性已启用，则返回 true。
                pub fn featureSetHas(set: Set, feature: F) bool {
                    return set.isEnabled(@backingInt(feature));
                }

                /// 如果任意指定特性已启用，则返回 true。
                pub fn featureSetHasAny(set: Set, features: anytype) bool {
                    inline for (features) |feature| {
                        if (set.isEnabled(@backingInt(@as(F, feature)))) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                /// 若所有指定特性均已启用，则返回 true。
                pub fn featureSetHasAll(set: Set, features: anytype) bool {
                    inline for (features) |feature| {
                        if (!set.isEnabled(@backingInt(@as(F, feature)))) return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            };
        }
    };

        fn allCpusFromDecls(comptime cpus: type) []const *const Cpu.Model {
            @setEvalBranchQuota(2000);
            const decl_names = @typeInfo(cpus).@"struct".decl_names;

            for (decl_names, 0..) |decl_name, i| {

            const finalized = array;

    pub const Model = struct {
        name: []const u8,
        llvm_name: ?[:0]const u8,
        features: Feature.Set,

        pub fn toCpu(model: *const Model, arch: Arch) Cpu {
            var features = model.features;
            features.populateDependencies(arch.allFeaturesList());
            return .{
                .arch = arch,
                .model = model,
                .features = features,
            };
        }

        /// 返回适用于 `arch` 的最基础 CPU 型号。注意，此函数
        /// 可能返回 LLVM 能识别、但 Clang *无法*识别的 CPU 型号。
        /// 如果需要兼容 Clang，请考虑改用 `baseline`。
        pub fn generic(arch: Arch) *const Model {
            return switch (arch) {
                .alpha => &alpha.cpu.ev4,
                .amdgcn => &amdgcn.cpu.gfx600,
                .avr => &avr.cpu.avr1,
                .hppa => &hppa.cpu.ts_1,
                .hppa64 => &hppa.cpu.pa_8000,
                .kvx => &kvx.cpu.coolidge_v1,
                .loongarch32 => &loongarch.cpu.generic_la32,
                .loongarch64 => &loongarch.cpu.generic_la64,
                .mips, .mipsel => &mips.cpu.mips32,
                .mips64, .mips64el => &mips.cpu.mips64,
                .nvptx, .nvptx64 => &nvptx.cpu.sm_20,
                .powerpc, .powerpcle => &powerpc.cpu.ppc,
                .powerpc64, .powerpc64le => &powerpc.cpu.ppc64,
                .propeller => &propeller.cpu.p1,
                .riscv32, .riscv32be => &riscv.cpu.generic_rv32,
                .riscv64, .riscv64be => &riscv.cpu.generic_rv64,
                .sparc64 => &sparc.cpu.v9, // SPARC 从 v9 起才支持 64 位。
                .wasm32, .wasm64 => &wasm.cpu.mvp,
                .x86_16 => &x86.cpu.i86,
                .x86 => &x86.cpu.i386,
                .x86_64 => &x86.cpu.x86_64,
                inline else => |a| &@field(Target, @tagName(a.family())).cpu.generic,
            };
        }

        /// 返回 `arch` 的保守 CPU 型号，预期兼容
        /// 绝大多数现有硬件。与 `generic` 不同，此函数保证返回的 CPU 型号
        /// 同时为 LLVM 和 Clang 所识别。
        ///
        /// 对于某些 `os` 值，此函数还会将基线提高到
        /// 高于仅由 `arch` 决定的水平；例如，`aarch64-macos` 的
        /// 基线视为 `apple_m1`。要完全避免此行为，请传入
        /// `Os.Tag.freestanding`。
        pub fn baseline(arch: Arch, os: Os) *const Model {
            return switch (arch) {
                .alpha => &alpha.cpu.ev6,
                .amdgcn => &amdgcn.cpu.gfx906,
                .arm => switch (os.tag) {
                    .@"3ds" => &arm.cpu.mpcore,
                    .vita => &arm.cpu.cortex_a9,
                    .gba => &arm.cpu.arm7tdmi,
                    else => &arm.cpu.baseline,
                },
                .thumb => switch (os.tag) {
                    .vita => &arm.cpu.cortex_a9,
                    .gba => &arm.cpu.arm7tdmi,
                    else => &arm.cpu.baseline,
                },
                .armeb, .thumbeb => &arm.cpu.baseline,
                .aarch64 => switch (os.tag) {
                    .haiku => &aarch64.cpu.cortex_a55,
                    .driverkit, .maccatalyst, .macos => &aarch64.cpu.apple_m1,
                    .ios, .tvos => &aarch64.cpu.apple_a7,
                    .visionos => &aarch64.cpu.apple_m2,
                    .watchos => &aarch64.cpu.apple_s4,
                    .@"switch" => &aarch64.cpu.cortex_a57,
                    else => generic(arch),
                },
                .avr => &avr.cpu.avr2,
                .bpfel, .bpfeb => &bpf.cpu.v3,
                .csky => &csky.cpu.ck810, // gcc/clang 没有通用 csky 模型。
                .hexagon => &hexagon.cpu.hexagonv68, // gcc/clang 没有通用 hexagon 型号。
                .hppa => &hppa.cpu.pa_7300lc,
                .kvx => &kvx.cpu.coolidge_v2,
                .lanai => &lanai.cpu.v11, // clang 没有通用 lanai 模型。
                .loongarch32 => &loongarch.cpu.la32v1_0,
                .loongarch64 => &loongarch.cpu.la64v1_0,
                .m68k => &m68k.cpu.M68030,
                .mips => &mips.cpu.mips32r2,
                .mipsel => switch (os.tag) {
                    .psx => &mips.cpu.r3000a,
                    .psp => &mips.cpu.allegrex,
                    else => &mips.cpu.mips32r2,
                },
                .mips64 => switch (os.tag) {
                    .openbsd => &mips.cpu.octeon,
                    else => &mips.cpu.mips64r2,
                },
                .mips64el => &mips.cpu.mips64r2,
                .msp430 => &msp430.cpu.msp430,
                .nvptx, .nvptx64 => &nvptx.cpu.sm_52,
                .powerpc => switch (os.tag) {
                    .openbsd, .wiiu => &powerpc.cpu.@"750",
                    else => generic(arch),
                },
                .powerpc64 => switch (os.tag) {
                    .linux, .freebsd => &powerpc.cpu.pwr8,
                    .openbsd => &powerpc.cpu.pwr9,
                    else => generic(arch),
                },
                .powerpc64le => &powerpc.cpu.ppc64le,
                .riscv32, .riscv32be => &riscv.cpu.baseline_rv32,
                .riscv64, .riscv64be => &riscv.cpu.baseline_rv64,
                .s390x => &s390x.cpu.arch11,
                .sparc => switch (os.tag) {
                    .linux => &sparc.cpu.v9, // glibc 无法与纯 v8 配合使用。
                    else => generic(arch),
                },
                .sparc64 => &sparc.cpu.ultrasparc,
                .x86 => &x86.cpu.pentium4,
                .x86_64 => switch (os.tag) {
                    .driverkit, .maccatalyst => &x86.cpu.nehalem,
                    .macos => &x86.cpu.core2,
                    .ps4 => &x86.cpu.btver2,
                    .ps5 => &x86.cpu.znver2,
                    else => generic(arch),
                },
                .xcore => &xcore.cpu.xs1b_generic,
                .xtensa => &xtensa.cpu.esp32,
                .wasm32, .wasm64 => &wasm.cpu.lime1,

                else => generic(arch),
            };
        }
    };

    /// 交叉编译的“默认”CPU 特性集。这是一组保守特性，预期绝大多数可用硬件都支持。
    ///
    pub fn baseline(arch: Arch, os: Os) Cpu {
        return Model.baseline(arch, os).toCpu(arch);
    }

    /// 若 `feature` 已启用，则返回 true。
    pub fn has(cpu: Cpu, comptime family: Arch.Family, feature: @field(Target, @tagName(family)).Feature) bool {
        if (family != cpu.arch.family()) return false;
        return cpu.features.isEnabled(@backingInt(feature));
    }

    /// 若 `features` 中任一特性已启用，则返回 true。
    pub fn hasAny(cpu: Cpu, comptime family: Arch.Family, features: []const @field(Target, @tagName(family)).Feature) bool {
        if (family != cpu.arch.family()) return false;
        for (features) |feature| {
            if (cpu.features.isEnabled(@backingInt(feature))) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// 若 `features` 中的所有特性均已启用，则返回 true。
    pub fn hasAll(cpu: Cpu, comptime family: Arch.Family, features: []const @field(Target, @tagName(family)).Feature) bool {
        if (family != cpu.arch.family()) return false;
        for (features) |feature| {
            if (!cpu.features.isEnabled(@backingInt(feature))) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

/// 此目标是否必须链接 libc？例如，目标系统调用接口
/// 不稳定时可能有此要求。
pub fn requiresLibC(target: *const Target) bool {
    return switch (target.os.tag) {
        .illumos,
        .driverkit,
        .ios,
        .maccatalyst,
        .macos,
        .tvos,
        .watchos,
        .visionos,
        .dragonfly,
        .haiku,
        .serenity,
        .emscripten,
        => true,

        // Android 29 之前的 API 级别不原生支持 TLS。这些 API 级别通过
        // 调用 `__emutls_get_address` 实现 TLS。我们在 compiler-rt
        // 提供此函数，但它通过 `pthread_key_create` 等函数实现，
        // 因此要求链接 libc。
        .linux => target.abi.isAndroid() and target.os.version_range.linux.android < 29,

        .windows,
        .freebsd,
        .netbsd,
        .openbsd,
        .freestanding,
        .fuchsia,
        .managarm,
        .rtems,
        .cuda,
        .nvcl,
        .amdhsa,
        .psx,
        .ps3,
        .ps4,

/// 用户可以指定地址空间属性的位置
pub const AddressSpaceContext = enum {
    /// 指定将函数置于特定地址空间。
    function,
    /// 指定将某个（全局）变量放入特定地址空间。
    /// 与 `.constant` 不同，这些值（因此也包括放置它们的地址空间）
    /// 必须可变。
    variable,
    /// 指定将某个（全局）常量值放入特定地址空间。
    /// 与 `.variable` 不同，放入此地址空间的值不要求可变。
    constant,
    /// 指针被标注为指向某个地址空间。
    pointer,
};

/// 返回此目标是否支持 `address_space`。若 `context` 为 `null`，
/// 此函数仅回答目标是否具备 `address_space` 概念
/// 这一一般问题；若非 `null`，则还会检查
/// `address_space` 在该上下文中是否有效。
pub fn supportsAddressSpace(
    target: Target,
    address_space: std.builtin.AddressSpace,
    context: ?AddressSpaceContext,
) bool {
    const arch = target.cpu.arch;

    const is_nvptx = arch.isNvptx();
    const is_spirv = arch.isSpirV();
    const is_gpu = is_nvptx or is_spirv or arch == .amdgcn;

    return switch (address_space) {
        .generic => true,
        .fs, .gs, .ss => (arch == .x86_64 or arch == .x86 or arch == .x86_16) and (context == null or context == .pointer),
        // 严格而言，x86 可以使用分段……
        .far => (arch == .x86_16),

        .flash, .flash1, .flash2, .flash3, .flash4, .flash5 => arch == .avr, // TODO：此处还应检查 CPU 具有多少个闪存存储体
        .cog, .hub => arch == .propeller,
        .lut => arch == .propeller and std.Target.propeller.featureSetHas(target.cpu.features, .p2),

        .global, .local, .shared => is_gpu,
        .private => is_spirv,
        .constant => (is_gpu and (context == null or context == .constant)) or
            (is_spirv and (context == null or context == .constant or context == .pointer)),
        .param => is_nvptx,
        .input, .output, .uniform, .push_constant, .storage_buffer => is_spirv,
        .physical_storage_buffer => arch == .spirv64,
        .externref, .funcref => target.cpu.has(.wasm, .reference_types),
    };
}

pub const DynamicLinker = struct {
    /// 包含用于存储动态链接器路径的内存。
    /// 不应直接使用此字段，参见 `get` 和 `set`。
    /// 此字段使该 API 无需分配器。
    buffer: [255]u8,

    /// 用于构造动态链接器路径。不应直接使用此字段。
    /// 参见 `get` 和 `set`。
    len: u8,

    pub const none: DynamicLinker = .{ .buffer = undefined, .len = 0 };

    /// 断言长度不超过 255 字节。
    pub fn init(maybe_path: ?[]const u8) DynamicLinker {
        var dl: DynamicLinker = undefined;
        dl.set(maybe_path);
        return dl;
    }

    pub fn initFmt(comptime fmt_str: []const u8, args: anytype) !DynamicLinker {
        var dl: DynamicLinker = undefined;
        try dl.setFmt(fmt_str, args);
        return dl;
    }

    /// 返回内存的生命周期与 `DynamicLinker` 相同。
    pub fn get(dl: *const DynamicLinker) ?[]const u8 {
        return if (dl.len > 0) dl.buffer[0..dl.len] else null;
    }

    /// 断言长度不超过 255 字节。
    pub fn set(dl: *DynamicLinker, maybe_path: ?[]const u8) void {
        const path = maybe_path orelse "";
        @memcpy(dl.buffer[0..path.len], path);
        dl.len = @intCast(path.len);
    }

    /// 断言长度不超过 255 字节。
    pub fn setFmt(dl: *DynamicLinker, comptime fmt_str: []const u8, args: anytype) !void {
        dl.len = @intCast((try std.mem.print(&dl.buffer, fmt_str, args)).len);
    }

    pub fn eql(lhs: DynamicLinker, rhs: DynamicLinker) bool {
        return std.mem.eql(u8, lhs.buffer[0..lhs.len], rhs.buffer[0..rhs.len]);
    }

    pub const Kind = enum {
        /// 没有动态链接器。
        none,
        /// 动态链接器路径由架构及操作系统组成部分决定。
        arch_os,
        /// 动态链接器路径由架构、操作系统及 ABI 组成部分决定。
        arch_os_abi,
    };

    pub fn kind(os: Os.Tag) Kind {
        return switch (os) {
            .fuchsia,

            .haiku,
            .illumos,
            .serenity,

            .dragonfly,
            .freebsd,
            .netbsd,
            .openbsd,

            .driverkit,
            .ios,
            .maccatalyst,
            .macos,
            .tvos,
            .visionos,
            .watchos,
            => .arch_os,
            .hurd,
            .linux,
            => .arch_os_abi,
            .freestanding,
            .other,

            .contiki,
            .hermit,
            .managarm, // 需要再次核对。

            .plan9,
            .rtems,

            .uefi,
            .windows,

            .@"3ds",
            .wiiu,
            .@"switch",
            .gba,

            .emscripten,
            .wasi,

            .amdhsa,
            .amdpal,
            .cuda,
            .mesa3d,
            .nvcl,
            .opencl,
            .opengl,
            .vulkan,

            .psx,
            .ps3,
            .ps4,
            .ps5,
            .psp,
            .vita,

            .tios,
            .ashetos,
            => .none,
        };
    }

    /// 此函数的严格程度由 `kind(os.tag)` 决定：
    ///
    /// * `.none`：忽略所有参数，仅返回 `none`。
    /// * `.arch_os`：忽略 `abi`，返回与 `cpu` 和 `os` 匹配的动态链接器。
    /// * `.arch_os_abi`：返回与 `cpu`、`os` 和 `abi` 匹配的动态链接器。
    ///
    /// 尤其在 `.arch_os` 情况下，调用方应注意：返回有效动态链接器，仅表示 `cpu` + `os` 组合对应一个实际存在的平台，且它具有不随 ABI 变化的既定动态链接器路径；并不一定表示 `abi` 对该平台有意义。此时，调用方负责判断 `abi` 是否有效。可使用 `Abi.default()` 为此类平台尽力选择默认 ABI。
    ///
    ///
    ///
    ///
    ///
    pub fn standard(cpu: Cpu, os: Os.Tag, abi: Abi) DynamicLinker {
        return switch (os) {
            .fuchsia => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .arm,
                .aarch64,
                .riscv64,
                .thumb,
                .x86_64,
                => init("ld.so.1"), // Fuchsia 的特殊之处在于 `DT_INTERP` 仅为基本文件名。
                else => none,
            },

            .haiku => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .arm,
                .aarch64,
                .riscv64,
                .x86,
                .x86_64,
                => init("/system/runtime_loader"),
                else => none,
            },

            .hurd => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .aarch64,
                .aarch64_be,
                => |arch| if (abi == .gnu) initFmt("/lib/ld-{s}.so.1", .{@tagName(arch)}) else none,

                .x86 => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib/ld.so.1") else none,
                .x86_64 => initFmt("/lib/ld-{s}.so.1", .{switch (abi) {
                    .gnu => "x86-64",
                    .gnux32 => "x32",
                    else => return none,
                }}),

                else => none,
            },

            .illumos,
            => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .x86,
                .x86_64,
                => initFmt("/lib/{s}ld.so.1", .{if (ptrBitWidth_cpu_abi(cpu, .none) == 64) "64/" else ""}),
                else => none,
            },

            .linux => if (abi.isAndroid())
                switch (cpu.arch) {
                    .arm => if (abi == .androideabi) init("/system/bin/linker") else none,

                    .aarch64,
                    .riscv64,
                    .x86,
                    .x86_64,
                    => if (abi == .android) initFmt("/system/bin/linker{s}", .{
                        if (ptrBitWidth_cpu_abi(cpu, abi) == 64) "64" else "",
                    }) else none,

                    else => none,
                }
            else if (abi.isMusl())
                switch (cpu.arch) {
                    .arm,
                    .armeb,
                    .thumb,
                    .thumbeb,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-arm{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        if (arch == .armeb or arch == .thumbeb) "eb" else "",
                        switch (abi) {
                            .musleabi => "",
                            .musleabihf => "hf",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                    }),

                    .loongarch32,
                    .loongarch64,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        @tagName(arch),
                        switch (abi) {
                            .musl => "",
                            .muslf32 => "-sp",
                            .muslsf => "-sf",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                    }),

                    .aarch64,
                    .aarch64_be,
                    .hexagon,
                    .kvx,
                    .m68k,
                    .microblaze,
                    .microblazeel,
                    .or1k,
                    .powerpc64,
                    .powerpc64le,
                    .s390x,
                    => |arch| if (abi == .musl) initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-{s}.so.1", .{@tagName(arch)}) else none,

                    .mips,
                    .mipsel,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-mips{s}{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        if (cpu.has(.mips, .mips32r6)) "r6" else "",
                        if (arch == .mipsel) "el" else "",
                        switch (abi) {
                            .musleabi => "-sf",
                            .musleabihf => "",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                    }),

                    .mips64,
                    .mips64el,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-mips{s}{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        switch (abi) {
                            .muslabi64 => "64",
                            .muslabin32 => "n32",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                        if (cpu.has(.mips, .mips64r6)) "r6" else "",
                        if (arch == .mips64el) "el" else "",
                    }),

                    .powerpc => initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-powerpc{s}.so.1", .{switch (abi) {
                        .musleabi => "-sf",
                        .musleabihf => "",
                        else => return none,
                    }}),

                    .sh,
                    .sheb,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-{t}{s}.so.1", .{
                        arch,
                        switch (abi) {
                            .musleabi => "-nofpu",
                            .musleabihf => "",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                    }),

                    .riscv32,
                    .riscv64,
                    => |arch| if (abi == .musl) initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        @tagName(arch),
                        if (cpu.has(.riscv, .d))
                            ""
                        else if (cpu.has(.riscv, .f))
                            "-sp"
                        else
                            "-sf",
                    }) else none,

                    .x86 => if (abi == .musl) init("/lib/ld-musl-i386.so.1") else none,

                    .x86_64 => initFmt("/lib/ld-musl-{s}.so.1", .{switch (abi) {
                        .musl => "x86_64",
                        .muslx32 => "x32",
                        else => return none,
                    }}),

                    else => none,
                }
            else if (abi.isGnu())
                switch (cpu.arch) {
                    .arc,
                    .arceb,
                    => |arch| if (abi == .gnu) initFmt("/lib/ld-linux-{t}.so.2", .{arch}) else none,

                    .arm,
                    .armeb,
                    => initFmt("/lib/ld-linux{s}.so.3", .{switch (abi) {
                        .gnueabi => "",
                        .gnueabihf => "-armhf",
                        else => return none,
                    }}),

                    .aarch64,
                    .aarch64_be,
                    .or1k,
                    => |arch| if (abi == .gnu) initFmt("/lib/ld-linux-{s}.so.1", .{@tagName(arch)}) else none,

                    .csky => initFmt("/lib/ld-linux-cskyv2{s}.so.1", .{switch (abi) {
                        .gnueabi => "",
                        .gnueabihf => "-hf",
                        else => return none,
                    }}),

                    .loongarch32,
                    .loongarch64,
                    => |arch| initFmt("/lib{s}/ld-linux-{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        switch (arch) {
                            .loongarch32 => "32",
                            .loongarch64 => "64",
                            else => unreachable,
                        },
                        switch (arch) {
                            .loongarch32 => "loongarch-ilp32",
                            .loongarch64 => "loongarch-lp64",
                            else => unreachable,
                        },
                        switch (abi) {
                            .gnu => "d",
                            .gnuf32 => "f",
                            .gnusf => "s",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                    }),

                    .hppa,
                    .m68k,
                    .microblaze,
                    .microblazeel,
                    .xtensa,
                    .xtensaeb,
                    => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib/ld.so.1") else none,

                    .mips,
                    .mipsel,
                    => switch (abi) {
                        .gnueabi,
                        .gnueabihf,
                        => initFmt("/lib/ld{s}.so.1", .{
                            if (cpu.has(.mips, .nan2008)) "-linux-mipsn8" else "",
                        }),
                        else => none,
                    },

                    .mips64,
                    .mips64el,
                    => initFmt("/lib{s}/ld{s}.so.1", .{
                        switch (abi) {
                            .gnuabi64 => "64",
                            .gnuabin32 => "32",
                            else => return none,
                        },
                        if (cpu.has(.mips, .nan2008)) "-linux-mipsn8" else "",
                    }),

                    .powerpc => switch (abi) {
                        .gnueabi,
                        .gnueabihf,
                        => init("/lib/ld.so.1"),
                        else => none,
                    },

                    .powerpc64 => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib64/ld64.so.1") else none,
                    .powerpc64le => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib64/ld64.so.2") else none,

                    .riscv32,
                    .riscv64,
                    => |arch| if (abi == .gnu) initFmt("/lib/ld-linux-{s}{s}.so.1", .{
                        switch (arch) {
                            .riscv32 => "riscv32-ilp32",
                            .riscv64 => "riscv64-lp64",
                            else => unreachable,
                        },
                        if (cpu.has(.riscv, .d))
                            "d"
                        else if (cpu.has(.riscv, .f))
                            "f"
                        else
                            "",
                    }) else none,

                    .s390x => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib/ld64.so.1") else none,

                    .sh,
                    .sheb,
                    => switch (abi) {
                        .gnueabi,
                        .gnueabihf,
                        => init("/lib/ld-linux.so.2"),
                        else => none,
                    },

                    .alpha,
                    .sparc,
                    .x86,
                    => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib/ld-linux.so.2") else none,

                    .sparc64 => if (abi == .gnu) init("/lib64/ld-linux.so.2") else none,

                    .x86_64 => switch (abi) {
                        .gnu => init("/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2"),
                        .gnux32 => init("/libx32/ld-linux-x32.so.2"),
                        else => none,
                    },

                    else => none,
                }
            else
                none, // 不是已知的 Linux libc。

            .serenity => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .aarch64,
                .riscv64,
                .x86_64,
                => init("/usr/lib/Loader.so"),
                else => none,
            },

            .dragonfly => if (cpu.arch == .x86_64) init("/libexec/ld-elf.so.2") else none,

            .freebsd => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .arm,
                .aarch64,
                .powerpc,
                .powerpc64,
                .powerpc64le,
                .riscv64,
                .x86,
                .x86_64,
                => init("/libexec/ld-elf.so.1"),
                else => none,
            },

            .netbsd => switch (cpu.arch) {
                .alpha,
                .arm,
                .armeb,
                .aarch64,
                .aarch64_be,
                .hppa,
                .m68k,
                .mips,
                .mipsel,
                .mips64,
                .mips64el,
                .powerpc,
                .riscv32,
                .riscv64,
                .sh,
                .sheb,
                .sparc,
                .sparc64,
                .x86,
                .x86_64,
                => init("/libexec/ld.elf_so"),
                else => none,

            .openbsd => switch (cpu.arch) {

            .driverkit,

            => switch (cpu.arch) {

                else => none,

            // 此列表中的操作系统已确认没有标准

            .freestanding,
            .other,

            .contiki,
            .hermit,

            .plan9,
            .rtems,

            .uefi,

            .@"3ds",

pub fn ptrBitWidth_cpu_abi(cpu: Cpu, abi: Abi) u16 {
    return ptrBitWidth_arch_abi(cpu.arch, abi);
}

pub fn ptrBitWidth_arch_abi(cpu_arch: Cpu.Arch, abi: Abi) u16 {
    switch (abi) {
        .gnux32,
        .muslx32,
        .x32,
        .gnuabin32,
        .muslabin32,
        .abin32,
        .ilp32,
        => return 32,
        else => {},
    }

    return switch (cpu_arch) {
        .avr,
        .msp430,
        .x86_16,
        .spork8,
        => 16,

        .ez80,
        => 24,

        .arc,
        .arceb,
        .arm,
        .armeb,
        .csky,
        .hexagon,
        .hppa,
        .kalimba,
        .lanai,
        .loongarch32,
        .m68k,
        .m88k,
        .microblaze,
        .microblazeel,
        .mips,
        .mipsel,
        .nvptx,
        .or1k,
        .powerpc,
        .powerpcle,
        .propeller,
        .riscv32,
        .riscv32be,
        .sh,
        .sheb,
        .sparc,
        .spirv32,
        .thumb,
        .thumbeb,
        .wasm32,
        .x86,
        .xcore,
        .xtensa,
        .xtensaeb,
        => 32,

        .aarch64,
        .aarch64_be,
        .alpha,
        .amdgcn,
        .bpfeb,
        .bpfel,
        .hppa64,
        .kvx,
        .loongarch64,
        .mips64,
        .mips64el,
        .nvptx64,
        .powerpc64,
        .powerpc64le,
        .riscv64,
        .riscv64be,
        .s390x,
        .sparc64,
        .spirv64,
        .ve,
        .wasm64,
        .x86_64,
        => 64,
    };
}

pub fn ptrBitWidth(target: *const Target) u16 {
    return ptrBitWidth_cpu_abi(target.cpu, target.abi);
}

pub fn stackAlignment(target: *const Target) u16 {
    // 栈对齐不等于指针位宽时使用的覆盖设置。
    switch (target.cpu.arch) {
        .ez80 => return 1,

        .m68k => return 2,

        .amdgcn => return 4,

        .arm,
        .armeb,
        .hppa,
        .lanai,
        .mips,
        .mipsel,
        .sparc,
        .thumb,
        .thumbeb,
        => return 8,

        .aarch64,
        .aarch64_be,
        .alpha,
        .bpfeb,
        .bpfel,
        .hppa64,
        .loongarch32,
        .loongarch64,
        .mips64,
        .mips64el,
        .sparc64,
        .ve,
        .wasm32,
        .wasm64,
        .x86_64,
        => return 16,

        // 以下部分分支实际上应检查 ABI，但当前的 `Abi` 枚举
        // 尚无法表达如此细致的差别。
        .powerpc64,
        .powerpc64le,
        => if (target.os.tag == .linux) return 16,

        .riscv32,
        .riscv32be,
        .riscv64,
        .riscv64be,
        => if (!target.cpu.has(.riscv, .e)) return 16,

        .x86 => if (target.os.tag != .windows and target.os.tag != .uefi) return 16,

        .kvx => return 32,

        .spork8 => return 256,

        else => {},
    }

    return @divExact(target.ptrBitWidth(), 8);
}

pub const StackGrowth = enum {
    down,
    up,
};

pub fn stackGrowth(target: *const Target) StackGrowth {
    // 严格来说，多数架构本身并不定义栈增长方向；
    // 完全可以认为这是 ABI 的属性。但现实中
    // 并非如此。此外，我们也没有指示不同
    // 栈增长 ABI 的机制，也无迫切用例需要创建这样的机制。
    return switch (target.cpu.arch) {
        .hppa,
        .hppa64,
        .spork8,
        => .up,
        else => .down,
    };
}

/// 此目标的本机 C 编译器中，`char` 默认是否有符号。
/// 注意，char 的符号属性由实现定义，且许多编译器提供
/// 覆盖默认符号属性的选项，例如 GCC 的 -funsigned-char / -fsigned-char。
/// 如果未为此目标定义 C ABI，则返回 `null`。
pub fn cCharSignedness(target: *const Target) ?std.builtin.Signedness {
    switch (target.os.tag) {
        .opengl => return null,
        else => {},
    }
    if (target.os.tag.isDarwin() or target.os.tag == .windows or target.os.tag == .uefi) return .signed;
    return switch (target.cpu.arch) {
        .aarch64,
        .aarch64_be,
        .arm,
        .armeb,
        .arc,
        .arceb,
        .csky,
        .ez80,
        .hexagon,
        .msp430,
        .powerpc,
        .powerpcle,
        .powerpc64,
        .powerpc64le,
        .s390x,
        .riscv32,
        .riscv32be,
        .riscv64,
        .riscv64be,
        .thumb,
        .thumbeb,
        .xcore,
        .xtensa,
        .xtensaeb,
        => .unsigned,
        else => .signed,
    };
}

pub const CType = enum {
    char,
    short,
    ushort,
    int,
    uint,
    long,
    ulong,
    longlong,
    ulonglong,
    float,
    double,
    longdouble,
};

/// 若此目标未定义 C ABI，则返回 `null`。
pub fn cTypeByteSize(t: *const Target, c_type: CType) ?u16 {
    return switch (c_type) {
        .char,
        .short,
        .ushort,
        .int,
        .uint,
        .long,
        .ulong,
        .longlong,
        .ulonglong,
        .float,
        .double,
        => @divExact(cTypeBitSize(t, c_type) orelse return null, 8),

        .longdouble => switch (cTypeBitSize(t, c_type) orelse return null) {
            64 => 8,
            80 => @intCast(std.mem.alignForward(usize, 10, cTypeAlignment(t, c_type).?)),
            128 => 16,
            else => unreachable,
        },
    };
}

/// 若此目标未定义 C ABI，则返回 `null`。
pub fn cTypeBitSize(target: *const Target, c_type: CType) ?u16 {
    return switch (target.os.tag) {
        .freestanding,
        .other,
        .ashetos,
        => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
            .msp430,
            .x86_16,
            => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort, .int, .uint => 16,
                .float, .long, .ulong => 32,
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double, .longdouble => 64,
            },
            .avr => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort, .int, .uint => 16,
                .long, .ulong, .float, .double, .longdouble => 32,
                .longlong, .ulonglong => 64,
            },
            // https://github.com/benanderman/spork-8/blob/main/Programming.md
            .spork8 => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort, .int, .uint => 16,
                .long, .ulong, .float => 32,
                .double, .longdouble, .longlong, .ulonglong => 64,
            },
            .mips64,
            .mips64el,
            => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => switch (target.abi) {
                    .abin32 => 32,
                    else => 64,
                },
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => 128,
            },
            .x86_64 => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => switch (target.abi) {
                    .x32 => 32,
                    else => 64,
                },
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => 80,
            },
            else => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => target.ptrBitWidth(),
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
                    .x86 => 80,

                    .alpha,
                    .riscv32,
                    .riscv32be,
                    .riscv64,
                    .riscv64be,
                    .aarch64,
                    .aarch64_be,
                    .powerpc,
                    .powerpcle,
                    .powerpc64,
                    .powerpc64le,
                    .s390x,
                    .sparc64,
                    .wasm32,
                    .wasm64,
                    .loongarch32,
                    .loongarch64,
                    .ve,
                    => 128,

                    else => 64,
                },
            },
        },

        .fuchsia,
        .hermit,

        .haiku,
        .hurd,
        .illumos,
        .linux,
        .plan9,
        .rtems,
        .serenity,

        .freebsd,
        .dragonfly,
        .netbsd,
        .openbsd,

        .wasi,
        .emscripten,
        => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
            .mips64,
            .mips64el,
            => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => switch (target.abi) {
                    .gnuabin32, .muslabin32, .abin32 => 32,
                    else => 64,
                },
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => 128,
            },
            .x86_64 => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => switch (target.abi) {
                    .gnux32, .muslx32, .x32 => 32,
                    else => 64,
                },
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => 80,
            },
            else => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => target.ptrBitWidth(),
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
                    .x86 => switch (target.abi) {
                        .android => 64,
                        else => 80,
                    },

                    .powerpc,
                    .powerpcle,
                    => switch (target.abi) {
                        .musleabi, .musleabihf => 64,
                        else => switch (target.os.tag) {
                            .netbsd,
                            .openbsd,
                            => 64,
                            else => 128,
                        },
                    },

                    .powerpc64,
                    .powerpc64le,
                    => switch (target.abi) {
                        .musl => 64,
                        else => switch (target.os.tag) {
                            .freebsd,
                            .openbsd,
                            => 64,
                            else => 128,
                        },
                    },

                    .alpha,
                    .riscv32,
                    .riscv32be,
                    .riscv64,
                    .riscv64be,
                    .aarch64,
                    .aarch64_be,
                    .s390x,
                    .mips64,
                    .mips64el,
                    .sparc64,
                    .wasm32,
                    .wasm64,
                    .loongarch32,
                    .loongarch64,
                    .ve,
                    => 128,

                    else => 64,
                },
            },
        },

        .windows, .uefi => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
            .x86 => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => 32,
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => switch (target.abi) {
                    .gnu => 80,
                    else => 64,
                },
            },
            .x86_64 => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => 32,
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => switch (target.abi) {
                    .gnu => 80,
                    else => 64,
                },
            },
            else => switch (c_type) {
                .char => 8,
                .short, .ushort => 16,
                .int, .uint, .float => 32,
                .long, .ulong => 32,
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
                .longdouble => 64,
            },
        },

        .driverkit,
        .ios,
        .maccatalyst,
        .macos,
        .tvos,
        .visionos,
        .watchos,
        => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
                .x86_64 => 64,
                else => switch (target.abi) {
                    .ilp32 => 32,
                    else => 64,
                },
            },
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
            .longdouble => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
                .x86_64 => 80,
                else => 64,
            },
        },

        .nvcl, .cuda => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong => switch (target.cpu.arch) {
                .nvptx => 32,
                .nvptx64 => 64,
                else => 64,
            },
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
            .longdouble => 64,
        },

        .amdhsa, .amdpal, .mesa3d => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong, .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
            .longdouble => 128,
        },

        .opencl, .vulkan => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong, .double => 64,
            .longlong, .ulonglong => 128,
            // 注：OpenCL 规范未保证 long double 的具体大小，
            // 但 clang 使用 128 位。
            .longdouble => 128,
        },

        .@"3ds" => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float, .long, .ulong => 32,
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double, .longdouble => 64,
        },

        .wiiu => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float, .long, .ulong => 32,
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double, .longdouble => 64,
        },

        .@"switch" => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong, .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
            .longdouble => 128,
        },

        .gba => switch (c_type) {
            .char => return 8,
            .short, .ushort => return 16,
            .int, .uint, .long, .ulong, .float => return 32,
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double, .longdouble => return 64,
        },

        .psx => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .long, .ulong, .float => 32,
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double, .longdouble => 64,
        },
        .ps4, .ps5 => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong => 64,
            .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => 64,
            .longdouble => 80,
        },
        .psp, .vita => switch (c_type) {
            .char => 8,
            .short, .ushort => 16,
            .int, .uint, .float => 32,
            .long, .ulong => 64,

        .tios => switch (c_type) {

        .opengl => null,

        .ps3,

}

/// 若此目标未定义 C ABI，则返回 `null`。
pub fn cTypeAlignment(target: *const Target, c_type: CType) ?u16 {
    // 特殊对齐要求的覆盖配置
    switch (target.cpu.arch) {
        .avr,
        .ez80,
        .spork8,
        => return 1,
        .x86 => switch (target.os.tag) {
            .windows, .uefi => switch (c_type) {
                .longlong, .ulonglong, .double => return 8,
                .longdouble => switch (target.abi) {
                    .gnu => return 4,
                    else => return 8,
                },
                else => {},
            },
            else => {},
        },
        .m68k => switch (c_type) {
            .int, .uint, .long, .ulong => return 2,
            else => {},
        },
        .wasm32, .wasm64 => switch (target.os.tag) {
            .emscripten => switch (c_type) {
                .longdouble => return 8,
                else => {},
            },
            else => {},
        },
        else => {},
    }

    // 对齐到下一个二的幂，但不超过最大值。
    return @min(
        std.math.ceilPowerOfTwoAssert(u16, ((cTypeBitSize(target, c_type) orelse return null) + 7) / 8),
        @as(u16, switch (target.cpu.arch) {
            .msp430,
            .x86_16,
            => 2,

            .arc,
            .arceb,
            .csky,
            .kalimba,
            .microblaze,
            .microblazeel,
            .or1k,
            .propeller,
            .sh,
            .sheb,
            .x86,
            .xcore,
            .xtensa,
            .xtensaeb,
            => 4,

            .amdgcn,
            .arm,
            .armeb,
            .bpfeb,
            .bpfel,
            .hexagon,
            .hppa,
            .lanai,
            .m68k,
            .m88k,
            .mips,
            .mipsel,
            .nvptx,
            .nvptx64,
            .s390x,
            .sparc,
            .thumb,
            .thumbeb,
            => 8,

            .aarch64,
            .aarch64_be,
            .alpha,
            .hppa64,
            .kvx,
            .loongarch32,
            .loongarch64,
            .mips64,
            .mips64el,
            .powerpc,
            .powerpcle,
            .powerpc64,
            .powerpc64le,
            .riscv32,
            .riscv32be,
            .riscv64,
            .riscv64be,
            .sparc64,
            .spirv32,
            .spirv64,
            .ve,
            .wasm32,
            .wasm64,
            .x86_64,
            => 16,

            .avr,
            .ez80,
            .spork8,
            => unreachable, // 已在上方处理。
        }),
    );
}

pub fn cCallingConvention(target: *const Target) ?std.builtin.CallingConvention {
    return switch (target.cpu.arch) {
        .x86_64 => switch (target.os.tag) {
            .windows, .uefi => .{ .x86_64_win = .{} },
            else => switch (target.abi) {
                .gnux32, .muslx32, .x32 => .{ .x86_64_x32 = .{} },
                else => .{ .x86_64_sysv = .{} },
            },
        },
        .x86 => switch (target.os.tag) {
            .windows, .uefi => if (target.isMinGW()) .{ .x86_mingw = .{} } else .{ .x86_win = .{} },
            else => .{ .x86_sysv = .{} },
        },
        .x86_16 => .{ .x86_16_cdecl = .{} },
        .aarch64, .aarch64_be => if (target.os.tag.isDarwin())
            .{ .aarch64_aapcs_darwin = .{} }
        else switch (target.os.tag) {
            .windows => .{ .aarch64_aapcs_win = .{} },
            else => .{ .aarch64_aapcs = .{} },
        },
        .alpha => .{ .alpha_osf = .{} },
        .arm, .armeb, .thumb, .thumbeb => switch (target.abi.float()) {
            .soft => .{ .arm_aapcs = .{} },
            .hard => .{ .arm_aapcs_vfp = .{} },
        },
        .mips64, .mips64el => switch (target.abi) {
            .gnuabin32, .muslabin32, .abin32 => .{ .mips64_n32 = .{} },
            else => .{ .mips64_n64 = .{} },
        },
        .mips, .mipsel => .{ .mips_o32 = .{} },
        .riscv64, .riscv64be => .{ .riscv64_lp64 = .{} },
        .riscv32, .riscv32be => .{ .riscv32_ilp32 = .{} },
        .sparc64 => .{ .sparc64_sysv = .{} },
        .sparc => .{ .sparc_sysv = .{} },
        .powerpc64 => if (target.os.tag == .ps3 or target.abi.isGnu())
            .{ .powerpc64_elf = .{} }
        else
            .{ .powerpc64_elf_v2 = .{} },
        .powerpc64le => .{ .powerpc64_elf_v2 = .{} },
        .powerpc, .powerpcle => .{ .powerpc_sysv = .{} },
        .wasm32, .wasm64 => .{ .wasm_mvp = .{} },
        .arc, .arceb => .{ .arc_sysv = .{} },
        .avr => .avr_gnu,
        .bpfel, .bpfeb => .{ .bpf_std = .{} },
        .csky => .{ .csky_sysv = .{} },
        .hexagon => .{ .hexagon_sysv = .{} },
        .hppa => .{ .hppa_elf = .{} },
        .hppa64 => .{ .hppa64_elf = .{} },
        .kalimba => null,
        .kvx => switch (target.abi) {
            .ilp32 => .{ .kvx_ilp32 = .{} },
            else => .{ .kvx_lp64 = .{} },
        },
        .lanai => .{ .lanai_sysv = .{} },
        .loongarch64 => .{ .loongarch64_lp64 = .{} },
        .loongarch32 => .{ .loongarch32_ilp32 = .{} },
        .m68k => .{ .m68k_gnu = .{} },
        .m88k => .{ .m88k_sysv = .{} },
        .microblaze, .microblazeel => .{ .microblaze_std = .{} },
        .msp430 => .{ .msp430_eabi = .{} },
        .or1k => .{ .or1k_sysv = .{} },
        .propeller => .{ .propeller_sysv = .{} },
        .s390x => .{ .s390x_sysv = .{} },
        .sh, .sheb => .{ .sh_gnu = .{} },
        .ve => .{ .ve_sysv = .{} },
        .xcore => .{ .xcore_xs1 = .{} },

        .amdgcn => .{ .amdgcn_device = .{} },
